name: dsh-xswt-tauriapp-plugin
description: Marketplace stub for the dsh-xswt-tauriapp desktop shell: on the first dsh start after install it downloads this platform's installer from the shell's GitHub release, verifies it against SHA256SUMS, and hands it to the operating system. 桌面外壳 dsh-xswt-tauriapp 的市场入口：安装后首次启动 dsh 时下载本平台安装包，用发布页的 SHA256SUMS 校验，再交给系统安装器。
